import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
import "date"
getOrDefault = (f, d) => if exists f then f else d
safeDivide = (numerator, denominator, default) => 
  if denominator != 0.0 then numerator / denominator else default  // Prevent division by zero

now_time = now()
current_year = date.year(t: now_time)
previous_year_start = time(v: string(v: current_year - 1) + "-01-01T00:00:00Z")
previous_year_end = time(v: string(v: current_year - 1) + "-12-31T23:59:59Z")
current_year_start = time(v: string(v: date.year(t: now_time)) + "-01-01T00:00:00Z")
current_year_end = time(v: string(v: date.year(t: now_time)) + "-12-31T23:59:59Z")

//query previous years data
prev_year_data = from(bucket: "default_agg_month")
  |> range(start: previous_year_start, stop: previous_year_end)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>  r._field == "total_user_cost" or r._field == "Total_Cost_Per_Api" )
  |> schema.fieldsAsCols()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time_prev: r._time,
      month: date.month(t: r._time),
      prev_user_cost: r.total_user_cost,
      prev_project_cost: r.Total_Cost_Per_Api,
    }))
  |>group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time_prev"], desc: true)  // Sort newest first

//query current years data
current_year_data = from(bucket: "default_agg_month")

  |> range(start: current_year_start, stop: current_year_end)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>  r._field == "total_user_cost" or r._field == "Total_Cost_Per_Api"  )
  |> schema.fieldsAsCols()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time_curr: r._time,
      month: date.month(t: r._time),
      current_user_cost: r.total_user_cost,
      current_project_cost: r.Total_Cost_Per_Api
    }))
  |>group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time_curr"], desc: true)  // Sort newest first

//join prev and current years data on month in order to identify the trends (hange in %)
joined_data = join(
  tables: {prev: prev_year_data, cur: current_year_data},
  on: ["month"],
  method: "inner"
)
 |> group()
    |> reduce(
        fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
          current_user_cost: getOrDefault(f: r.current_user_cost, d: 0.0) + accumulator.current_user_cost,
          prev_user_cost: getOrDefault(f: r.prev_user_cost, d: 0.0) + accumulator.prev_user_cost,
          current_project_cost: getOrDefault(f: r.current_project_cost, d: 0.0) + accumulator.current_project_cost,
          prev_project_cost: getOrDefault(f: r.prev_project_cost, d: 0.0) + accumulator.prev_project_cost,
   
  
        }),
        identity: {current_user_cost: 0.0, prev_user_cost: 0.0,current_project_cost: 0.0,prev_project_cost: 0.0}
    )
      |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time_prev: r._time_prev,
      _time_cur: r._time_cur,
      month: r.month,
      prev_user_cost: r.prev_user_cost,
      current_user_cost: r.current_user_cost,
      prev_project_cost: r.prev_project_cost,
      current_project_cost: r.current_project_cost,
     growth_rate_user: safeDivide(numerator: r.current_user_cost, denominator: r.prev_user_cost, default: 1.0),  // Default growth is 1.0 if prev_user_cost is 0
     growth_rate_project: safeDivide(numerator: r.current_project_cost, denominator: r.prev_project_cost, default: 1.0) 
    }))

// Calculate Growth Rate (Safe Division)
growth_rate_result_user = joined_data
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      growth_rate: r.growth_rate_user
    }))
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)  // Extract single growth rate value
growth_rate_result_project = joined_data
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({

      growth_rate: r.growth_rate_project
    }))
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)  // Extract single growth rate value

// Append Growth Rate as a Fixed Column in Current Year Data
current_year_data_with_growth_user = prev_year_data
|>sum(column:"prev_user_cost")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      month: r.month,
      prev_user_cost: r.prev_user_cost,
      growth_rate_user: growth_rate_result_user.growth_rate,  // Assign the computed fixed growth rate
      predicted_user_cos: r.prev_user_cost * growth_rate_result_user.growth_rate
    }))

current_year_data_with_growth_project = prev_year_data
|>sum(column:"prev_project_cost")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      month: r.month,
      prev_project_cost: r.prev_project_cost,
      growth_rate_project: growth_rate_result_project.growth_rate,  // Assign the computed fixed growth rate
      predicted_project_cos: r.prev_project_cost * growth_rate_result_project.growth_rate
    }))

// Output the modified current year data
current_year_data_with_growth_project
|> group()

list.query: if bucket_default_only then     data_default_start else if start_remainder_ns > 0 and end_remainder_ns > 0 then     union(tables: [data_default_start, data_agg, data_default_end]) else if start_remainder_ns > 0 then     union(tables: [data_default_start, data_agg]) else if end_remainder_ns > 0 then     union(tables: [data_agg, data_default_end]) else     data_agg

list.name: data_default_end
list.query: default_bucket_query(start: experimental.addDuration(d: -duration(v: end_remainder_ns), to: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)

list.name: data_default_start
list.query: default_bucket_query(         start: v.timeRangeStart,          stop: experimental.addDuration(d: duration(v: six_hours_ns - start_remainder_ns), to: v.timeRangeStart)     )     else if bucket_default_only then     default_bucket_query(         start: v.timeRangeStart,          stop: v.timeRangeStop     )

list.name: data_agg
